evidence_plan.requirement: Definition of an unordered text document
Existence of unordered text documents in real-world corpora

payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition of unordered text documents and confirms their existence in real-world corpora through experimental results.

claims.text: An unordered text document is one that contains sentences that are not arranged in a specific order, which can be structured based on keywords.
Unordered text documents arise in real-world corpora, as demonstrated by experiments conducted on Wikipedia documents.
